lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello madam, cyber police here. Your account has been hacked and money is going out right now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To stop the hackers we have to secure your account. Download the QuickSupport app and share your screen.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Don't cut the call and don't tell anyone, the hackers may be someone you know.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Now read me the code that came on your phone.
